title: Recycling at School
text:
Our school has a new recycling program. Every class has three bins: one for paper, one for plastic and one for food. Students put their rubbish in the right bin. The teachers say this helps the planet a lot.

Last month, the school collected over two hundred kilos of paper. The money from selling the paper will buy new books for the library. Many students now ask their families to recycle at home too. The program is a good example for the whole town.

questions.text: How many bins does each class have?
What will the money from selling the paper buy?
What can we infer about the teachers?
options: They do not want the students to recycle
They are tired of the program
They sell paper to earn money

questions.text: What can be inferred about the students' families?
options: They may start recycling at home
They refuse to recycle at all
They do not know about the program

vocabulary.definition: the process of using old materials again to make new things
gathered things from many places into one place
something that shows how a thing should be done

paragraph_translations: A nossa escola tem um novo programa de reciclagem. Cada turma tem três lixeiras: uma para papel, uma para plástico e uma para comida. Os alunos colocam o lixo na lixeira certa. Os professores dizem que isso ajuda muito o planeta.

No mês passado, a escola recolheu mais de duzentos quilos de papel. O dinheiro da venda do papel vai comprar livros novos para a biblioteca. Muitos alunos agora pedem às famílias que reciclem em casa também. O programa é um bom exemplo para a cidade inteira.
